lead_headline: Dairy Queen's Westminster location closure confirmed as Blazing Bird settles in — subscriber net flatlines at −1 for second day

restaurant.blurb: 2 new leads today: Dairy Queen Grill & Chill closures hardening across Westminster and Littleton as Blazing Bird cements its Sheridan Boulevard replacement, while The Perfect Crumb cottage bakery emerges in Elyria Swansea.

liquor.blurb: Zero applications for the fifteenth consecutive day as Colorado's liquor license system remains frozen through mid-May with no state communication on restoration timeline. The two-week blackout since April 29-30's 2,144-application renewal flood continues unabated — no new filings, no status changes, no backend movement across all license types. May's calendar stays completely dark through the 15th with officials offering no triage visibility or root cause analysis. The 7-day window holds at absolute zero for the third straight week.

Denver Post maintains dominance with 13 mentions (31% share), followed by Instagram (9) and Facebook (7). The two-mention Thursday matches Wednesday's trough before the week's earlier 8-mention daily peak, suggesting consistent midweek slowdown patterns. Google News RSS drives 95% of discoveries (40 of 42) as the week wraps with softer pickup than last Thursday's cycle. Monthly trajectory holds at 203 mentions with steady institutional sourcing.

subscriptions.blurb: Net −1 yesterday (0 new, 1 canceled) holds MTD at +15 (+1.1/day) while 90-day net edges down to +135. Wednesday's single cancellation with zero acquisition marks the third net-negative or flat day this week after Sunday and Tuesday, compressing the 7-day window to −2 (17 new, 19 canceled) — a 112% reversal from last week's +17 (21 new, 4 canceled). Acquisition dropped 19% week-over-week while cancellations quintupled, flipping from strong inbound momentum to sustained churn pressure. The last four days averaged −1 net versus the prior three-day stretch that delivered +3/day, exposing midweek retention strain even as MTD's +1.1/day rate tracks just below YTD's +1.3 baseline.
